title: [RC1] SMB/Close Loop stops after Calibrations
body:
There is a behaviour in AndroidAPS RC1 that I think should be reviewed. Everytime I calibrate using DexcomApp, and the value are very similar, AndroidAPS detects as two readings close to each other and stop the SMB/Close Loop.
In my opinion AndroidAPS should ignore "BG Check" values or the readings adjusted after calibration. This is happening to me quite often. I have to go manually remove the reading in red.
I can be wrong but I feel the issue is related to the BG value adjusted after the calibration.

Calibration was at 8:59 and SMB/Close Loop stop working around 9:30 +/- (as you can check in the graph.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1642156371451.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7869732/AndroidAPS_LOG_1642156371451.log.zip)

Yes, G5.
As I wrote it seems AndroidAPS marks as "red" reading the value adjusted really after the calibration.

@MilosKozak One note, the same problem happens when I initiate a new sensor and enter dual calibrations
Same problem with xDrip or BYOD. AndroidAPS assume the dual calibrations as two readings at near time and marked them as red.

fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/0603e741be6c6cd23d2d4b6c84c70de528b63a43
fixed for G5 BOYDA. no way to fix it in xdrip on AAPS side

Thank you @MilosKozak !

Regarding xDrip, what can be the solution? Changes on xDrip itself to avoid broadcast the calibrations?

i did only workaround as the issue is somewhere in G5 (maybe app only, who knows)
if you see the issue with xDrip too it must be analyzed there
